title: 二段式街路飲水台
description: 高さの異なる2つのボウル、押しボタン、排水グリル、点検扉を持つ公共空間向け飲水台。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Public-space fountain with two bowl heights, push buttons, drain grilles, curved bubblers and a service hatch. Visual prop, not certified accessibility hardware. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
